name: Rest
overview: Scripture reveals rest as a divine provision rooted in God's own example of ceasing work after creation, establishing a sacred rhythm for humanity. The commands to rest on the seventh day, even during busy seasons like harvest (Exodus 23:12, 34:21), and to observe holy convocations without servile work (Leviticus 23:7-8, 21), underscore rest as obedience and trust in God's care. Beyond physical rest, God promises His presence to grant true rest (Exodus 33:14), pointing forward to the spiritual and eternal rest available to believers who cease from self-effort and enter God's rest by faith.
